description: This file contains the implementation of the Cart class within the Opencart system, specifically handling cart operations such as displaying cart contents, removing products or vouchers, and managing cart-related data and responses.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: The Cart class manages the shopping cart operations, including displaying cart contents, removing products or vouchers, and generating the cart view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main cart view, assembling data such as totals, products, vouchers, and links, and returning the cart HTML view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns the cart view data as output.

methods.name: removeProduct
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to remove a product from the cart, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: removeVoucher
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to remove a voucher from the cart, returning a JSON response.
